business_problem: UFC needed to scale fight insight generation across more than 40 live events a year without depending solely on manual research and domain experts to analyze fast-changing performance data.
solution_summary: IBM and UFC built the UFC Insights Engine to automate how fight stories and statistics are generated for broadcast, digital and social teams. IBM watsonx Orchestrate sits at the center as the pre-fight insights agent and routing layer, enabling researchers to ask natural-language questions through a unified conversational interface. Behind that experience, IBM built text-to-SQL pipelines for structured queries and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using IBM Granite and Llama models for grounded responses. IBM watsonx.ai helps identify the key performance indicators that influence fight outcomes, while watsonx.data provides vectorized storage and retrieval and watsonx.governance supports explainability, relevance scoring and transparency. Terraform automates deployment of UI and API components. Together, these components transform fight statistics, athlete profiles and event history into reusable insight workflows that scale content creation across the UFC calendar.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Acts as the orchestration and conversational layer for UFC’s pre-fight insights agent.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Extracts and generates contextual fight insights from historical data and matchup statistics.

solution_components.name: IBM Granite
solution_components.role: Provides one of the grounded LLM options used in the RAG pipelines behind the Insights Engine.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Stores and retrieves vectorized fight and athlete data used to ground responses.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Adds explainability, relevance scoring and transparency to AI-generated responses.

data_flow: Historical fight statistics, athlete profiles and event outcomes are queried through text-to-SQL and RAG pipelines, grounded in watsonx.data, and then routed by watsonx Orchestrate to generate insights and narratives for UFC content teams.
business_outcome: UFC reduced the time needed to generate insights, tripled the volume of available content signals and gave its editorial teams a scalable way to enrich fan storytelling across events.
metrics: 40% estimated reduction in query generation time
